149  # -- Executors
150  def compute_and_execute_plan_to_target(self):
151  """
152  Firstly try to compute the plan to the set target.
153  If fails a first time, will try ComputePMaxTries times to stop the arm and recompute the plan
154  Then, execute the plan
155  :return: status, message
156  """
157  for tries in range(self.__compute_plan_max_tries + 1): # We are going to try 3 times
158  # if we are re-trying, first stop current plan
159  if tries > 0:
160  self.stop_current_plan()
161  rospy.sleep(0.1)
162 
163  plan = self.__get_computed_plan()
164  if not plan:
165  raise ArmCommanderException(CommandStatus.PLAN_FAILED, "MoveIt failed to compute the plan.")
166 
167  if self.__hardware_version == "ned":
168  self.__reset_controller()
169  rospy.loginfo("Arm commander - Send MoveIt trajectory to controller.")
170  status, message = self.execute_plan(plan)
171 
172  if status != CommandStatus.SHOULD_RESTART:
173  return status, message
174  if tries >= self.__compute_plan_max_tries:
175  rospy.logerr("Arm commander - Big failure from the controller. Try to restart the robot")
176  return (
177  CommandStatus.SHOULD_RESTART,
178  "Please restart the robot and try again.",
179  )
180  rospy.logwarn("Arm commander - Will retry to compute "
181  "& execute trajectory {} time(s)".format(self.__compute_plan_max_tries - tries))
182 
183  def __get_computed_plan(self):
184  """
185  Get computed plan from MoveIt
186  :return: the computed plan if MoveIt succeed else None
187  """
188  plan = self.__arm.plan()
189 
190  # handle changes between noetic / noetic
191  if isinstance(plan, RobotTrajectory):
192  return None if not plan.joint_trajectory.points else plan
193  else:
194  success, trajectory, planning_time, error_code = plan
195  if not success or not trajectory.joint_trajectory.points:
196  return None
197  else:
198  return trajectory

200  def compute_and_execute_cartesian_plan(self, list_poses, velocity_factor=1.0, acceleration_factor=1.0):
201  """
202  Compute a cartesian plan according to list_poses and then, execute it
203  The robot will follow a straight line between each points
204  If the plan is not validate, raise ArmCommanderException
205  :param list_poses:
206  :param velocity_factor:
207  :param acceleration_factor:
208  :return: status, message
209  """
210  if len(list_poses) == 0:
211  return GoalStatus.REJECTED, "No Waypoints"
212 
213  try:
214  plan = self.compute_cartesian_plan(list_poses)
215  except Exception:
216  raise ArmCommanderException(CommandStatus.ARM_COMMANDER_FAILURE, "IK Fail")
217 
218  if plan is None:
219  raise ArmCommanderException(
220  CommandStatus.NO_PLAN_AVAILABLE,
221  "The goal cannot be reached with a linear trajectory",
222  )
223 
224  # Apply robot speeds
225  plan = self.retime_plan(
226  plan,
227  velocity_scaling_factor=velocity_factor,
228  acceleration_scaling_factor=acceleration_factor,
229  optimize=False,
230  )
231  if plan is None:
232  raise ArmCommanderException(
233  CommandStatus.NO_PLAN_AVAILABLE,
234  "The goal cannot be reached with a linear trajectory",
235  )
236 
237  return self.execute_plan(plan)

239  def compute_cartesian_plan(self, list_poses, compute_max_tries=None):
240  """
241  Compute cartesian plan from a list of poses
242  As 2 poses cannot be the same, the first operation is to filter list_poses to be sure this condition is met
243  :param list_poses: list of Pose Object
244  :param compute_max_tries: number of tries to compute the path, if None the default value will be taken
245  :return: Computed plan : RobotTrajectory object
246  """
247  if len(list_poses) == 0:
248  return None
249 
250  for i in reversed(range(len(list_poses) - 1)):
251  if poses_too_close(list_poses[i + 1], list_poses[i]):
252  list_poses.pop(i)
253 
254  fraction = 0.0
255  for _ in range(compute_max_tries if compute_max_tries else self.__compute_plan_max_tries): # some tries
256  trajectory_plan, fraction = self.__arm.compute_cartesian_path(
257  list_poses, eef_step=self.__cartesian_path_eef_steps
258  )
259 
260  # Check the fraction value : if 1.0, the trajectory can be linear;
261  # else, the trajectory followed won't be linear.
262  if fraction == 1.0:
263  # delete the very first joints position which is the starting position (current),
264  # to avoid an error related to increasing time
265  # del trajectory_plan.joint_trajectory.points[0]
266  return trajectory_plan
267  else:
268  rospy.logwarn("Linear trajectory not found, only {}% was successfully computed.".format(fraction * 100))
269  return None
270 
271  def execute_plan(self, plan):
272  """
273  Execute the plan given
274  Firstly, calculate a timeout which is : 1.5 times *the estimated time of the plan*
275  Then send execute command to MoveIt and wait until the execution finished or the timeout happens
276  :param plan: Computed plan
277  :type plan: RobotTrajectory
278  :return: CommandStatus, message
279  """
280  if not plan:
281  raise ArmCommanderException(
282  CommandStatus.NO_PLAN_AVAILABLE,
283  "You are trying to execute a plan which doesn't exist",
284  )
285  # Reset
286  self.__traj_finished_event.clear()
287 
288  trajectory_time_out = max(1.5 * self.__get_plan_time(plan), self.__trajectory_minimum_timeout)
289 
290  self.__current_goal_id = None
291  self.__current_goal_result = GoalStatus.LOST
292  self.__cancel_goal = False
293 
294  # Send trajectory and wait
295  self.__arm.execute(plan, wait=False)
296  if self.__traj_finished_event.wait(trajectory_time_out):
297  if self.__current_goal_result == GoalStatus.SUCCEEDED:
298  return CommandStatus.SUCCESS, "Command has been successfully processed"
299  elif self.__current_goal_result == GoalStatus.PREEMPTED:
300  if self.__cancel_goal:
301  return (
302  CommandStatus.STOPPED,
303  "Command has been successfully stopped",
304  )
305 
306  self.__collision_detected_publisher.publish(True)
307  self.__set_learning_mode(True)
308  msg = "Command has been aborted due to a collision or a motor not able to follow the given trajectory"
309  return CommandStatus.COLLISION, msg
310 
311  elif self.__current_goal_result == GoalStatus.ABORTED:
312  # if joint_trajectory_controller aborts the goal, it will still try to
313  # finish executing the trajectory --> so we ask it to stop from here
314  # http://wiki.ros.org/joint_trajectory_controller -> preemption policy
315  # Send an empty trajectory from the topic interface
316  self.__set_position_hold_mode()
317  self.__set_learning_mode(True)
318  self.__collision_detected_publisher.publish(True)
319  msg = "Command has been aborted due to a collision or a motor not able to follow the given trajectory"
320  return CommandStatus.COLLISION, msg
321 
322  else: # problem from ros_control itself
323  self.__current_goal_id = None
324  return CommandStatus.SHOULD_RESTART, ""
325  else:
326  # This timeout will happen if something fails in ros_control
327  # It is not related to a trajectory failure
328  self.__current_goal_id = None
329  return CommandStatus.SHOULD_RESTART, ""

367  def retime_plan(
368  self,
369  plan,
370  velocity_scaling_factor=1.0,
371  acceleration_scaling_factor=1.0,
372  optimize=False,
373  ):
374  """
375  Take a plan and retime it

378  if self.__hardware_version == "one":
379  # for ros kinetic
380  plan_out = self.__arm.retime_trajectory(start_state, plan, velocity_scaling_factor=velocity_scaling_factor)
381  else:
382  if optimize:
383  algorithm = "time_optimal_trajectory_generation"
384  else:
385  algorithm = "iterative_time_parameterization"
386 
387  plan_out = self.__arm.retime_trajectory(
388  start_state,
389  plan,
390  velocity_scaling_factor=velocity_scaling_factor,
391  acceleration_scaling_factor=acceleration_scaling_factor,
392  algorithm=algorithm,
393  )
394  return plan_out

396  def __get_plan_start_robot_state(self, plan):
397  start_state = RobotStateMoveIt()
398  start_state.joint_state.header.frame_id = "world"
399  start_state.joint_state.position = plan.joint_trajectory.points[0].positions
400  start_state.joint_state.name = self.__joints_name

403  @staticmethod
404  def __get_plan_time(plan):
405  """
406  Extract duration from a plan. If it cannot be done, raise ArmCommanderException
407  :param plan: plan given by MoveIt
408  :type plan: RobotTrajectory
409  :return: duration in seconds
410  """
411  if plan and plan.joint_trajectory.points:
412  return plan.joint_trajectory.points[-1].time_from_start.to_sec()
413  else:
414  raise ArmCommanderException(CommandStatus.NO_PLAN_AVAILABLE, "No current plan found")

416  def link_plans(self, *plans):
417  # Link plans
418  if len(plans) < 2:
419  raise ArmCommanderException(CommandStatus.ARM_COMMANDER_FAILURE, "Not enough plans to link")
420  final_plan = plans[0]
421  combined_plan = RobotTrajectory()
422  combined_plan.joint_trajectory.header = final_plan.joint_trajectory.header
423  combined_plan.joint_trajectory.joint_names = (final_plan.joint_trajectory.joint_names)
424  combined_plan.joint_trajectory.points = []
425 
426  for plan in plans[1:]:
427  combined_plan.joint_trajectory.points.extend(plan.joint_trajectory.points)
428 
429  for attempt in range(1, self.__max_retries + 1):
430  new_plan = self.retime_plan(combined_plan, optimize=True)
431 
432  if new_plan != combined_plan:
433  break
434 
435  threshold = self.__proximity_step * attempt
436  points = combined_plan.joint_trajectory.points
437 
438  if len(points) < 2:
439  break
440 
441  filtered_points = [points[0]]
442  for i in range(1, len(points)):
443  if not joints_too_close_to_optimize(points[i].positions, filtered_points[-1].positions, threshold):
444  filtered_points.append(points[i])
445  else:
446  rospy.logdebug(f"Removing point {i} - distance < {threshold:.4f}")
447 
448  combined_plan.joint_trajectory.points = filtered_points
449 
450  final_plan.joint_trajectory.points.extend(combined_plan.joint_trajectory.points)
451  final_plan = self.retime_plan(final_plan, optimize=True)
452  return self.filtering_plan(final_plan)
453 
454  @staticmethod
455  def filtering_plan(plan):
456  if plan is None:
457  return None
458 
459  new_plan = RobotTrajectory()
460  new_plan.joint_trajectory.header = plan.joint_trajectory.header
461  new_plan.joint_trajectory.joint_names = plan.joint_trajectory.joint_names
462  new_plan.joint_trajectory.points = []
463 
464  for i, point in enumerate(plan.joint_trajectory.points[:-1]):
465  if (point.time_from_start != plan.joint_trajectory.points[i + 1].time_from_start):
466  new_plan.joint_trajectory.points.append(point)
467  new_plan.joint_trajectory.points.append(plan.joint_trajectory.points[-1])
468  return new_plan
